evals.prompt: Write a Sui Move module called `test_project::nft` that follows composable function design. Define an NFT object with key and store abilities, having id (UID), name (String), and description (String). Write a public function `mint` that takes name (String), description (String), and ctx (&mut TxContext) and RETURNS the NFT (do not transfer it inside the function). Write a public function `update_name` that takes &mut NFT and new_name (String) and updates the name field. Do not use 'entry' or 'public entry' — use 'public' only. Use Move 2024 edition syntax.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
mint returns NFT rather than transferring internally
